notes.title: Fight more efficiently, with coaxial machine guns!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43756176/f07eb78cb5f2dec5959979b52d773c56d254b79d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43756176/e2630740db4621b5b3dd0d862b727a362e1d3015.png[/img][/url]

You can use the coaxial machine gun to confirm the aiming status, switch the main battle ammunition instantly, and hit the target more accurately

It is also a good choice to clean up dying enemies！
